articles.title: China confirms first AI talks with U.S. have taken place, hints at trade truce extension
articles.description: Chinese confirmation of the AI discussions came just hours before President Xi Jinping was scheduled to begin talks with U.S. President Donald Trump.

articles.title: Switzerland is keeping rates at 0% — for now
articles.description: The Swiss National Bank held rates at 0% as low inflation and a strong franc enable it to diverge from other central banks, though markets expect hikes ahead.

articles.title: Bitcoin falls below $84K as 10-year Treasury yield hits 19-year high
articles.description: Bitcoin traded near $83,200 as Fed hike odds reached about 75% and Treasury prepared a $6 billion buyback of long-dated bonds.

articles.title: Traders price in 4 Fed rate hikes by June 2027 as bitcoin slides below $83,000
articles.description: The four-hike path is the most likely outcome, while rising bond yields and a stronger dollar weigh on bitcoin and gold.

articles.title: Cyber startup Island hits $6.4 billion valuation in new round as AI attacks fuel spending wave
articles.description: Island faces an increasingly competitive cybersecurity market fueled by demand for agentic Ai defenses

articles.title: Stephen Curry says WNBA needs to keep conversations about the league 'focused on basketball'
articles.description: NBA star Stephen Curry, an investor in women's sports, says the WNBA's next commissioner should keep conversations about the league "focused on basketball."

articles.title: The data proves it: Bitcoin doesn't care about rising bond yields over long-term
articles.description: Long-term, BTC ignores rising bond yields. In the short term, however, surging bond volatility could easily dampen crypto's animal spirits.

articles.title: 30-year Treasury yield hits highest level since 2004
articles.description: U.S. Treasury yields continued their upward momentum after hitting a 19-year high on Wednesday.

articles.title: EU financial watchdogs warn quantum computing poses imminent threat to blockchain encryption
articles.description: The warning brings renewed urgency to the debate over how bitcoin should deal with legacy addresses whose public keys are already exposed onchain.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs add $347M as BTC falls below $84K after topping $87K
articles.description: US spot Bitcoin ETF inflows slowed to $347 million on Wednesday as Bitcoin fell below $84,000, while five-day inflows reached $2.65 billion.

articles.title: Institutions held crypto through 50% drawdown, Bitwise finds
articles.description: Every institution interviewed that owned crypto held Bitcoin, usually as its largest asset; some set exit conditions for Ether and Solana.

articles.title: New York Fed’s Williams says it's 'reasonable' to expect another rate hike by year-end
articles.description: John Williams was speaking at the London Macro Policy Forum on Thursday.

articles.title: Brooklyn Man Who Bragged About $16M Coinbase Scam Gets Up to 12 Years
articles.description: He posed as support staff, emptied about 100 accounts, then lost $6 million of the proceeds gambling, according to his own messages.

articles.title: Oil prices rise sharply as investors seek progress on U.S.-Iran talks
articles.description: Oil rose Thursday, as traders assess a report that Asia is on track to import its highest volume of crude oil since the start of the US-Iran war.

articles.title: Australia says OpenAI agent hacked government site before Altman warning
articles.description: OpenAI notified Australia nearly three months after its agent breached a government portal while gathering public medicine-spending data.

articles.title: Global debt tops $365 trillion as economists sound alarm over 'vicious cycle'
articles.description: More is being paid out by advanced economies in debt interest than the whole world spends on AI, defense or clean technology.

articles.title: Tehran criticizes Canada for not condemning Trump's threat to destroy Iran

articles.title: Trump administration weighs a global stablecoin plan to cement dollar's dominance
articles.description: Washington is a mulling plan to actively promote USD-backed stablecoins worldwide in a bid to cement the greenback's global reserve status.

articles.title: Judge lifts Trump ban on CNN, MS NOW, Politico from White House
articles.description: District Judge Tim Kelly said the three outlets should have their access immediately restored from the ban that the president had announced on Sept. 18.

articles.title: France's fresh budget battle threatens to topple another government
articles.description: Time is not on the side of French government bonds, strategists have warned, as the nation's deficit balloons.
